batch: India central official records — expansion batch
policy: All candidates are pending_validation. They are not active or healthy. HTML pages require page-specific extraction adapters; any RSS/API source requires endpoint validation and explicit licence review. No new API credentials are required or embedded.

candidates.category: constitutional election authority and election records
candidates.licenceEvidence: Official Government of India portal/source page. Endpoint is a discovery candidate only; endpoint validation, extraction adapter and reuse/licence review are still required.
candidates.provenance: Discovered from the official Election Commission of India website; page-level extraction and reuse review pending.
